news.headline: Earnings To Watch: Abivax SA (XPAR:ABVX) Reports Q2 2026 Result
Goldman Sachs Initiates Abivax at Buy, $155 Price Target, Calls Obefazimod a "Multiblockbuster"
news.summary: Goldman Sachs started coverage of Abivax ADSs with a Buy rating and $155 price target, modeling roughly EUR 4bn peak sales in ulcerative colitis plus an additional EUR 3.5bn in Crohn's disease. The stock jumped on the initiation, pushing shares to a session high near $115 and extending an already near-unanimous Buy-rated sell-side base (consensus target now around $155, roughly 29% above the prevailing ADS price).

news.headline: STAT News: "The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?"
news.summary: STAT's Adam Feuerstein examined why, nine months into a record biotech M&A year in which a roughly $20bn takeout of Abivax was widely treated as imminent, no deal has materialized. The piece frames the delay as timing and process rather than a broken thesis, noting the $920M July raise instead funds a solo US launch and reduces seller urgency.

news.headline: Bank of America Crosses 5% Ownership Threshold in Abivax (AMF Filing)
news.summary: Bank of America Corporation declared to the AMF that it crossed above the 5% threshold of Abivax capital and voting rights indirectly through controlled entities, its second such crossing this year. The filing points to continued institutional accumulation ahead of the September 21 H1 2026 results.

news.headline: Abivax Named Among Three Top Immunology Takeover Targets in PharmaVoice Dealmaking Analysis
news.summary: PharmaVoice profiled Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as one of immunology's most talked-about M&A candidates, citing the ABTECT maintenance data and a roughly $25bn addressable IBD market by 2030. CEO Marc de Garidel is quoted dismissing earlier Eli Lilly buyout chatter as "noise."

news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 Review: Obefazimod Sustains Week-44 Remission With No Dose-Dependent Malignancy Signal
news.summary: A clinical review of the Phase 3 ABTECT Part 2 maintenance package confirmed that 37.2% of induction non-responders reached clinical remission and 34.5% endoscopic remission at Week 44 on continued 50 mg obefazimod. Malignancy and non-melanoma skin cancer rates were consistent with UC background rates with no apparent dose-dependent signal, further de-risking the safety database ahead of the Q4 2026 NDA filing.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. It confirms that a dedicated biotech specialist held on through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

catalysts.label: Euronext CAC annual index review outcome
catalysts.detail: The CAC Steering Committee met September 10, 2026; as of September 11 the outcome still had not been published. Any changes would take effect after close on the following Friday (around September 18). Abivax already moved up to the CAC Next 20/CAC Large 60 in the June 2026 review, so a further step is plausible given its roughly $10bn market cap.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax has this date fixed in its published financial calendar. The report will show the first post-raise balance sheet (cash was EUR 491.6m at March 31, 2026 before the $920m July offering, with runway now guided into 2029) and the step-up in R&D and pre-launch commercial spend. It is the next confirmed company communication and the first chance since July 30 for management to address the M&A question directly.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at an autumn gastroenterology congress (UEG Week / ACG)
catalysts.detail: Abivax has a consistent pattern of taking full datasets to autumn congresses (it did so at UEG Week Berlin in October 2025). A detailed public presentation of the Week-44 maintenance efficacy and the complete malignancy/safety database would be the cleanest way to fully retire the June cancer-signal overhang. No venue or date for a 2026 autumn congress has been announced yet.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction data, the 44-week maintenance readout, the Part 2 refractory-patient dataset and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA for obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists Q3 2026 results for December 14, 2026. By then the FDA submission should either have happened or be days away, so the release is the natural venue for confirming the NDA filing and giving first guidance on review type and expected PDUFA timing.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) 44-week maintenance data. Recent communication has emphasised the Q4 2026 FDA filing without restating a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed and could slip into H1 2027.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027. Goldman Sachs' September 10 initiation models roughly EUR 3.5bn of peak Crohn's sales on top of the UC opportunity, making this the main pipeline-diversification event.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision and U.S. launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted. The commercial organisation being hired since July 2026 is being built against this window.

pulse: Ten days out from the September 21 H1 2026 results, Abivax remains an unacquired, closely-watched standalone story: the September 3 STAT piece questioning why a rumored ~$20bn takeout hasn't happened is still unanswered, and the Euronext CAC index review that met on September 10 had still not published its outcome as of September 11. Sell-side conviction keeps building regardless - Goldman Sachs initiated at Buy with a $155 target on September 10 ("multiblockbuster" obefazimod thesis across UC and Crohn's), and Bank of America's fresh 5% AMF threshold crossing (Sept 2) extends a run of institutional accumulation (TCG Crossover, Invus, BofA) into the earnings date. Shares trade in the $110-120 ADS range, with the fundamental picture unchanged: the ABTECT maintenance/safety package remains clean (no dose-dependent malignancy signal through Week 44) and management is executing a solo US launch funded by the $920M July raise ahead of the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing, rather than waiting on a suitor.
